# Proofbench

> Open-source Agent Skills and MCP servers for AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI): bug analysis, regression tracing with git bisect, proven bug fixes, feature development, code cleanup, security audits, Android APK reverse engineering and ticket reading. Skills trigger automatically from plain sentences; scores are computed by MCP servers from recorded evidence.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what it is, install for each assistant, FAQ, safety model
- [Skills](skills/README.md): the seven skills and the router
- [APK analysis guide](docs/apk-analysis.md): the 14 apk-inspector tools, bytecode and caller-check analysis, optional jadx bridge, limits
- [apk-inspector](mcp/apk-inspector/README.md): MCP server for static APK analysis
- [regression-tracer](mcp/regression-tracer/README.md): MCP server for regression investigations
- [workflow-gate](mcp/workflow-gate/README.md): MCP server for proof-backed workflows
- [Vision](docs/VISION.md): promise, target, risks
